original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 0 Embedded Controller Firmware Minor Release component equals the approved EC firmware recipe, or the approved not-specified state, and remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Bind Type 0 EC revision to the intended controller/image, preserve combined major/minor representation, extract the minor component without floating-point conversion, compare with the manifest or sentinel, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves EC mapping, expected minor component and plan. Core read, parse, reboot and comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Expected minor component including leading-zero semantics or sentinel
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; no EC write/update path is authorized.
Preserve raw Type 0 and distinguish absence, sentinel and zero.
Treat minor as a discrete component and retain leading-zero/display semantics.
Stop on wrong-controller mapping, parsing ambiguity, drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect Type 0/tool/EC identity, extract exact minor/sentinel from a verified representation and compare before/after reboot.
Do not infer EC identity, flash firmware or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve applicability, mapping, expected minor/sentinel and recovery.
Resolve discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Fragile because the literal minor label may not exist in human-readable output; stderr suppression and insecure transport are also unsuitable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full sudo dmidecode -t 0 and tool version/errors, verify combined EC revision rendering and parse minor as a discrete component before/after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The linked script, EC minor scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Tie the combined EC revision to the exact controller/image, retain major/minor and sentinel, and compare the minor component exactly without decimal conversion across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 0 platforms implementing EC firmware release fields.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode/script, BIOS and EC image versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform EC firmware manifest and SMBIOS field baseline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds controller identity, component-safe parsing and unsupported-state handling.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: EC mapping, expected minor and sentinel rule.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Multiple embedded controllers or a branded EC version can make an unbound numeric match misleading.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a not-specified sentinel only with platform evidence; a missing line alone is not success.
expected_evidence: Approval, EC mapping/applicability, expected minor and tool versions
Raw pre-reboot Type 0 plus minor extraction

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion coherently target the EC minor field; project mapping/value are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field semantics are defined; missing EC mapping/package does not permanently block the master case.

review_improvement: Prevents zero/sentinel/absence or the wrong controller's version from being treated as an EC minor match.
